cohort: 23 newborns with fetal heart block born between January 1, 2007 and June 30, 2020 at a tertiary referral hospital
finding: Planned vaginal delivery for selected women carrying a fetus with fetal heart block was found to be safe, with all live babies in the vaginal delivery group having an Apgar score greater than seven at five minutes.
mod_finding: Of the 12 women who planned a vaginal delivery, 8 had a normal birth, 3 had an unplanned caesarean section, and 1 had a planned caesarean section.
gest_age: Median gestational age at birth of 37.2 weeks
